title: Scorch Release
body:
Scorch Release forms from Fire + Wind. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Heat Needle (help heat needle)
Level 45: Scorching Mirage (help scorching mirage)
Level 70: Burning Horizon (help burning horizon)
